en.name: YAML to JSON Converter
en.description: Convert YAML data to JSON format online. This YAML to JSON converter lets you convert YAML to JSON and transform YAML config files into JSON objects, with support for anchors, aliases, multi-line strings, and nested structures — a free YAML to JSON online tool.

hero.trustHtml: 100% client-side conversion. Your data never leaves your browser.

meta.title: YAML to JSON — Free Online Converter
meta.description: Convert YAML to JSON format online. Transform YAML config files into JSON objects with configurable indentation. Free, fast, and 100% client-side. No upload required.

features.title: YAML Import
features.description: Paste YAML data directly or upload .yaml/.yml files to convert. The tool supports common YAML structures from Kubernetes, Docker Compose, CI/CD configs, and other sources.

features.title: JSON Export
features.description: Download the converted JSON as a .json file or copy the output to your clipboard. Use the result in APIs, scripts, frontend applications, or other JSON-based workflows.

features.title: Indentation Options
features.description: Choose 2 or 4 spaces for JSON output formatting. This helps match your project's code style and readability preferences.

features.title: Full YAML Support
features.description: Supports standard YAML features including anchors (&), aliases (*), multi-line strings (|, >), and deeply nested structures. Complex YAML is faithfully converted to JSON.

features.title: File Upload
features.description: Upload .yaml or .yml files directly from your device for conversion. The file is read locally in your browser and is not uploaded to any server.

features.title: Private
features.description: All YAML parsing and JSON conversion happen in your browser. Your data is not uploaded to a server, which is useful when working with private configuration files or sensitive environment variables.

guide.title: Paste your YAML
guide.description: Paste your YAML document into the input field or upload a .yaml/.yml file. You can use Kubernetes manifests, Docker Compose files, CI/CD configs, or any YAML structure you need to convert to JSON.

guide.title: Configure indentation
guide.description: Select 2 or 4 spaces for JSON indentation. Two spaces are common in many codebases, while four spaces can improve readability for deeply nested structures.

guide.title: Click Convert
guide.description: Click Convert to JSON to transform the YAML into a JSON object. The tool preserves the structure, handles anchors and aliases, and converts multi-line strings correctly.

guide.title: Copy or Download
guide.description: Copy the JSON output to your clipboard or download it as a .json file. Use the result in frontend applications, APIs, data pipelines, or other JSON-based workflows.

  host: localhost
  port: 5432
  name: myapp
example.useCase: Convert YAML configuration files to JSON for Node.js applications.

faq.question: Is my YAML data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All YAML parsing and JSON conversion happen locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device and is not stored or transmitted anywhere.

faq.question: Can I convert JSON back to YAML?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a JSON to YAML converter tool to transform JSON documents back into YAML format. This is useful when moving data between JSON-based and YAML-based systems.

faq.question: Does it support multi-document YAML?
faq.answer: The converter processes single YAML documents. For multi-document YAML (using --- separators), convert each document separately to JSON.

faq.question: Can I convert large YAML files?
faq.answer: You can convert larger YAML files as long as they can be loaded and processed by your browser. The practical limit depends on available memory, device performance, and the complexity of the YAML structure.

faq.question: What YAML features are supported?
faq.answer: The converter supports standard YAML features including anchors (&), aliases (*), multi-line strings (|, >), and nested structures. Complex YAML is faithfully converted to equivalent JSON.

faq.question: What is YAML commonly used for?
faq.answer: YAML is widely used for configuration files (Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines), data serialization, and human-readable data exchange. Its concise syntax makes it popular for DevOps and infrastructure-as-code workflows.

faq.question: How are YAML anchors and aliases handled?
faq.answer: Anchors and aliases are resolved during conversion, so the resulting JSON contains the expanded values. This ensures the JSON output is self-contained and does not rely on YAML-specific features.

faq.question: Is this a free YAML to JSON converter?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free online YAML to JSON converter. You can paste YAML or upload files, configure indentation, and copy or download the JSON output without creating an account or uploading data to a server.

faq.question: 我的 YAML 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有 YAML 解析和 JSON 转换都在浏览器本地完成，数据不会离开你的设备，也不会被存储或传输到任何地方。

faq.question: 可以把 JSON 转回 YAML 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。使用 JSON 转 YAML 转换器工具可以将 JSON 文档转换回 YAML 格式。这在需要在基于 JSON 和基于 YAML 的系统之间移动数据时非常有用。

faq.question: 支持多文档 YAML 吗？
faq.answer: 转换器处理单个 YAML 文档。对于多文档 YAML（使用 --- 分隔符），请分别将每个文档转换为 JSON。

faq.question: 可以转换大型 YAML 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以转换较大的 YAML 文件，只要浏览器能够加载和处理它们。实际限制取决于设备性能、浏览器可用内存以及 YAML 结构的复杂程度。

faq.question: 支持哪些 YAML 特性？
faq.answer: 支持标准 YAML 特性，包括锚点 (&)、别名 (*)、多行字符串 (|, >) 和嵌套结构。复杂 YAML 会被忠实地转换为等价的 JSON。

faq.question: YAML 常用于什么场景？
faq.answer: YAML 广泛用于配置文件（Kubernetes、Docker、CI/CD 流水线）、数据序列化和人类可读的数据交换。其简洁语法使其在 DevOps 和基础设施即代码工作流中非常流行。

faq.question: YAML 锚点和别名怎么处理？
faq.answer: 锚点和别名会在转换过程中被解析和展开，因此生成的 JSON 包含展开后的值。这确保 JSON 输出是自包含的，不依赖 YAML 特有的特性。

faq.question: 这是一个免费的 YAML 转 JSON 转换器吗？
faq.answer: 是的。这是一个免费的在线 YAML 转 JSON 转换器。你可以粘贴 YAML 或上传文件，配置缩进，并复制或下载 JSON 输出，无需创建账号或将数据上传到服务器。
